title: Interest Rate Buydown Eligibility Matrix
content:
This matrix sets the file-level limits of each Interest Rate Buydown product offered by Larkspur Home Lending: the loan programs, loan purposes, occupancies and property types it may be used with, the credit score, loan-to-value and loan term limits, the loan file statuses in which it may be elected, and whether it may be combined with a permanent buydown on the same file.

## Loan programs the buydown may be used with

| Loan program | Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown is for conventional programs only: the four programs marked Yes in its column.

## Purpose, occupancy and property type

| Product | Loan purposes | Occupancies | Property types |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | purchase | primary residence, second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | purchase | primary residence, second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | purchase | primary residence, second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | purchase | primary residence, second home | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | single-family detached, townhouse, condominium, two-to-four unit, manufactured home |

## Score, loan-to-value, term, rate type, file status and combination

| Product | Minimum representative credit score | Maximum base-loan-to-value | Minimum loan term | May be used on an adjustable-rate loan | Loan file statuses in which it may be elected | Can be combined with a permanent buydown on the same file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | 620 | 97.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | 620 | 97.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | 620 | 97.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | 660 | 95.00% | 360 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | No |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | 580 | 100.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | 580 | 100.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | 580 | 100.00% | 180 months | No | processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | Yes |

The credit score is the representative credit score of the loan file; the loan-to-value is the base loan-to-value. A minimum is met by a figure equal to it, and a maximum is met by a figure equal to it.

## Reading the matrix (hypothetical files)

- **Boundary of the credit score.** A hypothetical file with a representative score of 620 is within the Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown minimum of 620; a score of 619 is not. The same 620 score is below the Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown minimum of 660 and above the 580 minimum of the permanent products.
- **Boundary of the loan-to-value.** A base loan-to-value of 97.00% is within the 97.00% maximum of the Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown; 97.01% is not. Under the Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown the maximum is 95.00%, so 95.00% is within it and 95.01% is not.
- **Boundary of the term.** A hypothetical 180-month loan term meets the 180-month minimum of the Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown, but not the 360-month minimum of the Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown.
- **A refinance file.** A hypothetical rate-and-term refinance of an investment property under the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program falls within the program, purpose and occupancy columns of the three permanent products only.
